Since I own the land, I take care of it, but I will not spend too much cash on this small plot — my bigger plots get the fertilizer first. I will put some manure from my oxen on it because that costs me nothing, and I will use my own saved seed as I have done before. I do not have irrigation here, so I depend on the meher rains, and my family will do most of the work ourselves.
